description: Chart Architecture Refactoring: Introduce ChartContext shared data structure, perfect indicator alignment, and extracted X-axis. Builds on Feature 4 bug fixes to establish clean, extensible architecture for future indicators (MACD, Stochastic).
principles: Rock-solid quality over speed - every feature must be bulletproof before moving on
Comprehensive test coverage - unit tests, integration tests, edge cases
All tests must pass before a story is marked complete
No story is done until it's documented and tested
INCREMENTAL REFACTORING - each story must leave the codebase in a working state
BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY - old interfaces work during transition
Apply learnings from AGENTS.md - no ANSI codes in Textual, use Rich markup, explicit heights

CRITICAL_RENDERING_NOTES.warning: ⚠️ READ THIS BEFORE ANY WIDGET/RENDERING WORK ⚠️
CRITICAL_RENDERING_NOTES.textual_colors: Textual uses Rich markup, NOT ANSI escape codes!
CRITICAL_RENDERING_NOTES.wrong_syntax: \033[32m (ANSI codes will BREAK rendering in Textual widgets)
CRITICAL_RENDERING_NOTES.label_markup: When Label contains Rich markup, you MUST set markup=True
CRITICAL_RENDERING_NOTES.volume_bars_note: Volume bars in chart_renderer.py use Rich markup [green][/green] and [red][/red]
CRITICAL_RENDERING_NOTES.indicator_panel_note: IndicatorPanel uses [cyan] for data and reference line colors via Rich markup

background.prerequisite: Feature 4 must be complete and merged. Feature 4 fixes the core layout bugs (volume/RSI occlusion, RSI stale data) and removes volume toggle complexity.
startingState: Volume bars always visible (no toggle) - from Feature 4
RSI panel toggles without occluding volume/X-axis - from Feature 4
RSI updates correctly on ticker change - from Feature 4
Height calculations work correctly - from Feature 4
goals: Introduce ChartContext as single source of truth for dimensions
Perfect pixel alignment between price chart and indicators
Extract X-axis to be rendered once at bottom
Establish clean architecture for future indicators (MACD, Stochastic)

targetArchitecture.model: TradingView-style: Price chart with embedded volume at bottom, then stacked indicator panels
targetArchitecture.overview: ChartPanel (orchestrator) → ChartContext (shared data) → Price+Volume section → IndicatorPanel[] → Shared X-Axis
targetArchitecture.ChartPanel_role: Orchestrates layout: creates ChartContext, calculates heights, renders components in order
targetArchitecture.ChartContext_role: Immutable dataclass holding ticker, period, dates, prices, volumes, and calculated dimensions
targetArchitecture.price_section: Fixed proportion of available space, volume permanently attached at bottom (always visible)
targetArchitecture.indicator_section: RSI (and future MACD, Stochastic) stacked below with fixed heights, receive ChartContext for alignment
targetArchitecture.x_axis: Rendered ONCE at very bottom via render_x_axis(context), shared by all components
targetArchitecture.height_management: ChartPanel calculates total layout, passes dimensions via ChartContext, children render within bounds
targetArchitecture.alignment_guarantee: All components use context.chart_area_width and context.y_axis_width for perfect horizontal alignment

knownIssuesFromFeature4: rsi-defect-1-width-mismatch.md - RSI panel hardcoded 70 chars vs dynamic chart width (fixed by VPR-051)
Hardcoded y_axis_padding in indicator_panel.py (fixed by VPR-051)

userStories.title: Create ChartContext dataclass for shared dimensions
acceptanceCriteria: New file: viper/widgets/chart_context.py
ChartContext dataclass with frozen=True for immutability
Fields: ticker, period, dates, prices, volumes, opens, closes
Fields: total_width, total_height, y_axis_width (default 12)
Computed property: chart_area_width = total_width - y_axis_width
Factory classmethod: from_historical_data(data: HistoricalData, width: int, height: int)
DO NOT integrate yet - just create the dataclass with unit tests
100% test coverage on the new module
userStories.notes: Foundation dataclass created in isolation. Simple, testable, no side effects.

criticalLearningsFromAgentsMd: NEVER use ANSI escape codes for colors in Textual widgets - use Rich markup ([green]text[/green])
Label widgets need markup=True to render Rich markup colors
Textual CSS height: auto and 1fr can conflict - prefer explicit heights for predictable layout
Widget compose() defines structure, _render_content() updates dynamic content
Use container.remove_children() + mount() pattern for dynamic updates
RSI panel uses [cyan] Rich markup for indicator line, reference lines use [red]/[green]
architecturePrinciples: Single source of truth: ChartContext holds all shared dimensions
Parent orchestrates: ChartPanel calculates total layout, children render within bounds
Immutable data: ChartContext is frozen, safe to pass around
Consistent interface: All indicators extend IndicatorPanel with same contract
Explicit heights: Don't rely on CSS auto-sizing for predictable layouts
testingStrategy: Unit tests for ChartContext creation and immutability
Unit tests for X-axis rendering in isolation
Integration tests for RSI alignment with price chart
Visual testing: manual verification with screenshots

outOfScope: New indicators (MACD, Stochastic) - future feature, but this architecture enables them
Overlapping volume on price chart (semi-transparent) - would require different rendering
Multiple Y-axes for indicators - each indicator has own scale
Horizontal scrolling/panning - complex feature for later
successMetrics: RSI indicator horizontally aligns PERFECTLY with price chart data points
X-axis appears once at bottom, readable in all toggle states
ChartContext is the single source of truth for dimensions
